title: Piercing Frame Solo #072 (일반 허리 컷 · P25 집중형 · 크라운브레이드 · 파스텔라벤더 · 메이크업 페르시안글램 · 금속 구리 · 재질 혼합 3종(나비날개비늘+이레즈미+석재) · 부채꼴 · 체형 근육형 아워글래스·단단한 배 · 배꼽 링)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, waist shot. ONE woman, facing the camera straight on, her head level, both ears clearly visible on either side of her face, framed from the very top of her head down to just below her navel, the frame cutting off across her lower belly. Her face sits in the upper part of the frame, large enough to read every piercing, and her ear pieces are oversized so they read clearly at this distance. Mid 20s.

Subject: A real photograph of a strikingly beautiful adult Iranian woman — richly kohl-lined almond eyes, a deep berry-red lip, thick dark brows, warm olive skin, soft pastel-lavender hair styled in a crown braid wrapping around the head. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain — a photograph of a real woman, not an illustration, not a render.

Piercings: All twenty-five piercings gather mostly on the left side of her face, and the right side stays almost bare: on the left ear eight oversized pieces — a huge copper clicker ring hanging clear of the neck down to the shoulder, a wide copper ear cuff, three smaller copper rings, two thick copper bars and a small copper stud up to the top; one small copper stud sits in the right ear; four copper pieces in a row along the outer half of the left eyebrow, alternating small rings that pass through the brow skin with the skin visible through each loop and small round ball studs sitting on the skin; two small copper rings pass through the left nostril and a thick copper septum ring hangs below the nose; a copper hoop passes through the left edge of the lower lip with a copper snake-bite ring beside it and a small copper ring at the left edge of the upper lip; a copper Medusa stud sits above the lips; a copper labret stud and a small copper ring sit on the chin; three small copper studs run along the left jaw. Each piece carries small opals set into the metal. A copper ring passes through the rim of her navel, the navel itself a deep dimple set in the smooth swell of her belly. All jewelry is real copper, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar and surface bar is embedded in the skin — its middle runs beneath the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface, the skin between them faintly raised over the hidden bar, with a small warm shadow at each end and nothing lying on top of the skin like a sticker. Every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden. Where a bar, ring or stud goes through the ear, the lip, the nostril or the brow, it passes through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around it.

Physique: a muscular hourglass with a firm, smooth belly and strong arms.

Body: Below the collarbones her whole body is fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin, covering every inch from the collarbones to the bottom of the frame without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her body below the collarbones is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 54% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 6 o'clock, 11 o'clock and 4 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 11 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC BLUE scale formations, VIVID DEEP BLACK scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the wedge between the 11 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, koi sakura formations in CRIMSON and PINK, extreme high-gloss oil finish. Region 3 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries solid polished white marble fused directly into her own form, natural grey-gold veining flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING pale marble surface with VIVID golden vein striations. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her chest, shoulders and arms, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Real skin on the face, ears and neck ends cleanly at the base of the neck and across both collarbones, and everything below it, down to the bottom of the frame, is the body treatment described above.

Pose: arms relaxed at her sides, shoulders level, head level toward the camera.

Lighting: pure pitch black background. A soft frontal light on her face and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
